set.body: Independent review of source transition commit caea1d7c0 reproduced Unit(parent="") passing make_account/validate_supported_account because _AccountFields.validate_relations checks if unit.parent. The new projection boundary refuses it at42924603a; existing account admission remains permissive. Tighten the common account parent check without changing valid IDs or wire schemas, with direct/forged/JSON refusal and None/existing-parent controls. Source transition regression test_projection_refuses_empty_primary_parent_in_direct_and_forged_accounts records the current producer/consumer distinction.
set.title: Reject empty unit parent IDs at account admission
